
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/20055306" title="发布于 2026-05-15 18:29">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【Azure Developer】ASP.NET Framework 4.8 集成 Azure Application Insights SDK 完整指南</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>前言</h1>
<p>在生产环境中，应用性能监控是保障系统稳定运行的关键一环，特别是部署到云上的服务，但是，由于.Net Framework 4.8项目年代久远，无法实现一些无代码的方式集成获取日志数据。</p>
<p>而Azure Application Insights提供了两种方式：无代码 ， 集成SDK的方式来实现日志收集。它提供了强大的请求追踪、依赖调用分析、异常捕获和性能指标收集能力。所以本文将详细介绍如何在 ASP.NET Framework 4.8 项目中集成 Application Insights SDK。</p>
<h1>选择正确的 SDK 版本</h1>
<p>ASP.NET Framework 与 ASP.NET Core 使用不同的 NuGet 包，请勿混淆：</p>
<div style="text-align: left" align="center">
<table border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p><strong>框架</strong></p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p><strong>NuGet 包</strong></p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p><strong>当前推荐版本</strong></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>ASP.NET Framework 4.6.2+</p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web</p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>2.22.x</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>ASP.NET Core</p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore</p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>2.22.x</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>Worker Service / Console</p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.WorkerService</p>
</td>
<td style="text-align: left" valign="top" width="192">
<p>2.22.x</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>对于 .NET Framework 4.8 项目，我们使用 <strong>Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web</strong>。</p>
<p>注意：请使用 <strong>Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web</strong> &nbsp;2.23.0</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202605/2127802-20260515182926489-787256517.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>安装该包后会自动引入以下组件：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Microsoft.ApplicationInsights</strong> — 核心 SDK，提供 TelemetryClient</li>
<li><strong>Microsoft.AI.Web</strong> — 自动追踪 HTTP 请求和响应</li>
<li><strong>Microsoft.AI.DependencyCollector</strong> — 自动追踪 SQL 查询、HTTP 外部调用等依赖项</li>
<li><strong>Microsoft.AI.PerfCounterCollector</strong> — 收集 CPU、内存等性能计数器</li>
<li><strong>Microsoft.AspNet.TelemetryCorrelation</strong> — 分布式追踪关联</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>&nbsp;<img alt="" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202605/2127802-20260515182926425-413770362.png" class="lazyload"></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>集成步骤</h1>
<h2>第一步：安装 NuGet 包</h2>
<p>在 Visual Studio 中打开 Package Manager Console，执行：</p>
<p>Install-Package Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web -Version 2.23.0</p>
<p>或者通过 NuGet Package Manager UI 搜索 Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web 并安装2.23.0版。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>第二步：配置 Connection String</h2>
<p>安装完成后，项目根目录会自动生成 ApplicationInsights.config 文件。</p>
<p>打开该文件，配置 Connection String：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;?</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">?&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ApplicationInsights </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">xmlns</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="http://schemas.microsoft.com/ApplicationInsights/2013/Settings"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ConnectionString</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>InstrumentationKey=xx-x-x-x-xxx;EndpointSuffix=applicationinsights.azure.cn;IngestionEndpoint=https://chinanorth3-0.in.applicationinsights.azure.cn/;LiveEndpoint=https://chinanorth3.livediagnostics.monitor.azure.cn/;AADAudience=https://monitor.azure.cn/;ApplicationId= xx-x-x-x-xxx <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ConnectionString</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryInitializers</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自动生成的初始化器配置 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryInitializers</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryModules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自动生成的模块配置 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryModules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ApplicationInsights</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>PS：示例使用的是中国区的Azure Application Insights 服务，所以Connection String指向中国区 endpoint：IngestionEndpoint=https://dc.applicationinsights.azure.cn/;LiveEndpoint=https://live.applicationinsights.azure.cn/</p>
<p>也可以使用环境变量 APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING来保存连接字符串。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>第三步：验证 web.config 配置</h2>
<p>NuGet 包安装时会自动修改 web.config，添加两个关键的 HTTP Module。</p>
<p>请确认以下配置存在：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system.webServer</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">modules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">remove </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="TelemetryCorrelationHttpModule"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">add </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="TelemetryCorrelationHttpModule"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
           type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Microsoft.AspNet.TelemetryCorrelation.TelemetryCorrelationHttpModule, Microsoft.AspNet.TelemetryCorrelation"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
           preCondition</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="managedHandler"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">remove </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ApplicationInsightsWebTracking"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">add </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ApplicationInsightsWebTracking"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
           type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web.ApplicationInsightsHttpModule, Microsoft.AI.Web"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
           preCondition</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="managedHandler"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">modules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system.webServer</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>提示：</strong>这两个 Module 的顺序很重要 — TelemetryCorrelationHttpModule 必须在前，负责分布式追踪的上下文传播。</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202605/2127802-20260515182926571-698421391.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>第四步：发送自定义遥测数据（可选）</h2>
<p>SDK 安装后，请求、依赖、异常等已自动收集。</p>
<p><img alt="" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202605/2127802-20260515182926485-1837101413.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>如需发送自定义事件或指标：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.ApplicationInsights;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.DataContracts;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OrderController : Controller
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> TelemetryClient _telemetryClient = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TelemetryClient();
…
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 追踪自定义事件</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            _telemetryClient.TrackEvent(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test event</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                { </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">event ID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Guid.NewGuid().ToString() },
                { </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">event Title</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">this is custome events title 20260514</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   }
            });

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 追踪自定义指标</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            _telemetryClient.TrackMetric(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">customer metrics</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Random()).NextDouble());
…
}<br></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>第五步：验证数据上报</h2>
<p>1. 本地运行项目，触发几个页面请求</p>
<p>2. 打开 Azure Portal → Application Insights 资源</p>
<p>3. 进入Search，确认能看到请求遥测数据</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="ai show insights" width="999" height="486" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202605/2127802-20260515182847428-62462323.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4. 检查 Live Metrics，确认实时数据流正常</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img width="999" height="745" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202605/2127802-20260515182926477-1785913000.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>注意：</strong>数据从应用发送到 Portal 通常有 2-5 分钟延迟，Live Metrics 则是实时的。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>常见问题与注意事项</h1>
<h2>1. App Service Auto-Instrumentation 冲突</h2>
<p>如果你的应用部署在 Azure App Service 上，并且开启了 Application Insights 的 Auto-Instrumentation（代码无侵入式监控），不要同时在代码中安装 SDK。两者同时存在会导致：</p>
<ul>
<li>重复的遥测数据</li>
<li>性能下降</li>
<li>依赖追踪异常</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>解决方案：</strong>二选一。推荐使用 SDK 方式（更灵活可控），并将 App Service 的 ApplicationInsightsAgent_EXTENSION_VERSION 设为 disabled。</p>
<h2>2. 采样配置</h2>
<p>生产环境中高流量场景下，建议配置自适应采样以控制成本：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ApplicationInsights</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryProcessors</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Add </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.WindowsServer.TelemetryChannel.AdaptiveSamplingTelemetryProcessor, Microsoft.AI.ServerTelemetryChannel"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MaxTelemetryItemsPerSecond</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MaxTelemetryItemsPerSecond</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Add</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryProcessors</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ApplicationInsights</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<h2>3. 关于 OpenTelemetry 迁移</h2>
<p>微软目前推荐新项目使用 OpenTelemetry + Azure.Monitor.OpenTelemetry.Exporter。但该方案目前仅支持 ASP.NET Core。对于 .NET Framework 4.8 项目，Classic SDK（Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web）仍是官方支持的方案，短期内不会被废弃。</p>
<h2>4. SDK 诊断日志</h2>
<p>如遇到数据不上报的问题，可开启 SDK 自诊断：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryModules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Add </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Extensibility.Implementation.Tracing.FileDiagnosticsTelemetryModule, Microsoft.ApplicationInsights"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Severity</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>Verbose<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Severity</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LogFileName</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>ai-sdk-diag.txt<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LogFileName</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LogFilePath</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>D:\home\LogFiles\ApplicationInsights<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LogFilePath</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Add</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TelemetryModules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
